exclusion_reasons.Stroke_Risk_Score: Every observed Stroke_Risk_Score value maps to exactly one Stroke_Risk class (100% class separation); observed class ranges are High: 65-100; Low: 2-34; Moderate: 35-64. This is direct target encoding in this dataset. Exclude from training and inference.
exclusion_reasons.AI_Health_Recommendation: Each observed AI_Health_Recommendation value occurs with only one Stroke_Risk class. This makes the recommendation a target proxy and it is likely produced after risk assessment. Exclude from training and inference.
exclusion_reasons.Doctor_Consultation_Needed: Doctor_Consultation_Needed is Yes for 100.00% of High-risk rows and has different rates in the other target classes. Consultation is a likely downstream action; timing/provenance cannot be verified from the CSV. Exclude to avoid target-policy leakage.

identifier_reasons.Patient_ID: Identifier-like column name; 50,000 unique non-null values among 50,000 rows (100.00%). Exclude from predictors.

selection_note: Safe features are provisional candidates based on this dataset's observed leakage checks. Confirm that each value is available at the intended time of prediction before model development.

preparation_policy.exact_duplicates: Drop exact duplicate rows in the prepared copy only.
preparation_policy.blood_pressure: Exclude rows with both pressure values present and systolic less than or equal to diastolic; do not alter source values.
preparation_policy.missing_values: Keep missing values in the prepared table; imputation must be fit on training data only using the configured preprocessor.
preparation_policy.non_finite_numeric: Convert positive/negative infinity to missing values.
preparation_policy.categorical_text: Trim leading/trailing whitespace and map blanks to missing.
